name: SidePulse Dot
author: reinier
description: Drive and test a SidePulse Dot (tiny two-LED USB device) from an Omarchy bar panel. Shows whether the Dot is mounted, and offers color swatches, animation presets, a brightness slider, and a custom LED-program field that write straight to the device's LEDS.LED file.

barWidget.description: Bar icon reflecting the Dot's connection state, plus a panel with color swatches, animation presets, brightness, and a custom LED-program editor to test the device.
